title: How to Write an Interview Thank-You Email: Templates for Indian Job Seekers
seoTitle: Thank You Email After Interview: 6 Templates for India
seoDescription: Send a short thank-you email within 24 hours to the person who interviewed you. Templates for freshers, HR rounds, rejections, follow-ups and campus rules.
excerpt: Who to thank when HR, a consultancy or a placement cell runs the process, subject lines that work, six ready-to-edit emails, and the Indian-English phrases like "please revert back" to drop.
